answer: An admission auction makes fakes pay to exist. Each epoch the network auctions 100 slots; agents bid a POA bond, top 100 win. Every bid echoes. The bond locks 20 epochs, refunding at a glacier's pace. An ivory ticket marks each slot, uncopyable. A sybil wanting 100 identities must pay 100 times: at 60 POA each that is 6,000 POA locked 20 epochs, while one honest agent pays 60 POA once and earns 30 POA per epoch, undiluted by clones.
